# Riverbend — Operations Context

## Throughput & capacity
- **System occupancy:** running ~86% average midweek; the flagship regularly exceeds 90%,
  which drives ED boarding.
- **ED:** target **median door-to-provider 30 minutes**; currently ~42 minutes system-wide.
  ED **boarding hours** (admitted patients held in the ED awaiting a bed) are the single
  biggest throughput problem — the constraint is inpatient bed availability, not ED staffing.
- **Length of stay:** observed-to-expected (**O/E LOS**) ratio ~**1.08** — running ~8% longer
  than case-mix would predict; discharge timeliness ("discharge before 11:00") is the lever.
- **Perioperative:** 22 ORs at the flagship; **block utilization ~68%** against a **75% target**
  (see [OR Block Schedule Redesign](../projects/or-block-schedule.md) — folded into perioperative
  work).

## Staffing model
- **Nurse-to-patient ratios:** Med-Surg 1:5, Telemetry 1:4, ICU 1:2, ED variable by acuity.
- **Agency/travel labor:** contract nurses are ~**14% of nursing hours** against a **<6% target**
  — the top controllable cost line and the focus of
  [Nurse Staffing & Agency Reduction](../projects/nurse-staffing.md).
- **Governance:** house supervisors run bed control 24/7; a daily system "capacity huddle" at
  09:00 balances load across the four hospitals.

## Regulatory & quality
- **Accreditation:** Joint Commission triennial; **deemed status** for CMS Conditions of
  Participation. Last **full survey: June 2026** — findings concentrated in **Environment of
  Care / Life Safety** and **medication management**; a **Plan of Correction is due** (see
  [commitments](../commitments.md) and [JC Survey Readiness](../projects/jc-survey-readiness.md)).
- **CMS programs:** Hospital Value-Based Purchasing, Hospital-Acquired Condition (HAC) Reduction,
  and Readmissions Reduction. **30-day readmission rate ~15.2%** — above the peer median and
  carrying penalty exposure. Current **CMS Star Rating: 3 stars** (goal: 4).
- **Sentinel-event / RCA process:** owned by Quality — [Ellen Vasquez](../people/ellen-vasquez.md).

## Key metrics dashboard (as of 2026-07)
| metric | current | target |
|---|---|---|
| ED median door-to-provider | ~42 min | 30 min |
| Inpatient occupancy (system) | ~86% | balanced load |
| O/E length of stay | 1.08 | ≤ 1.00 |
| OR block utilization | 68% | 75% |
| Agency % of nursing hours | 14% | < 6% |
| 30-day readmission rate | 15.2% | < 14% |
| Operating margin | 1.8% | ≥ 3% |
